sentences: A distance-labeling scheme attaches information to vertices so their distance can be recovered from their labels.
Here the graph is planar and the distances must be exact.
The saved question asks for optimal labels, making representation size the central resource.
An efficient scheme would support pairwise distance queries without consulting the entire original graph.
The index does not specify edge weights, decoder time, or whether optimality means maximum or total label length, and these distinctions prevent a precise size target from being asserted.
